status: actual registered source schemas; handlers not executed for schema capture

tools.name: capture_sources
tools.description: List local X11 windows and application audio streams. Native Wayland windows are not supported.

display.description: Optional local X11 display, such as :0.

tools.name: capture_start
tools.description: Start recording one selected visible X11 window. Optionally route ONE explicitly selected audio stream into a temporary recording sink; playback is muted until recording stops. Recording stops automatically at max_seconds.

window_id.description: Hex window ID returned by capture_sources.

capture_mode.description: window records the selected drawable. Explicit window_region records its fixed on-screen rectangle, including dialogs/overlapping pixels inside it. Use a private display; keep unrelated windows/notifications away, and do not move/resize the selected window.

show_cursor.description: Show the real pointer in the recording; useful for guided tutorials. Default false.

audio_stream.description: Optional exact audio stream ID returned by capture_sources; omitted means silent video.

tools.name: capture_status
tools.description: Read recording state, media duration and step markers.

tools.name: capture_mark
tools.description: Mark a demonstration step on the current media timeline, approximately half-second precision.

tools.name: capture_stop
tools.description: Stop this plugin-owned recording and restore its selected audio route.

tools.name: capture_export
tools.description: Cut ordered segments from a completed recording into a checked H.264 MP4, at most 89 seconds. Original recording is preserved.

tools.name: tutorial_timeline
tools.description: Read source-video or exported-video timestamps, including the mapping of recorded step markers through the chosen cuts.

tools.name: tutorial_frame
tools.description: Decode a frame at a requested export timestamp so the agent can inspect what actually appears before writing narration. Returns a local PNG path; no image model is called.

tools.name: tutorial_narrate
tools.description: Generate timestamped narration and mix it into a completed export. Default route: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS through your own Google Cloud login, one request per cue, a named voice (see capture_sources, speech section) and a spend guard; other routes are a configured local speech service or a host speech tool. Measures every clip, refuses overruns without speeding/cutting speech, caches unchanged cues, and writes segment captions plus the speech credit and usage. Does not start or install a model.

tools.name: tutorial_step
tools.description: Perform ONE computer-use action through Hermes's native tool, with its approvals unchanged, while a take is recording. Mark the attempt on the media timeline and return a fresh capture for verification. A tool acknowledgment is not proof the intended UI result occurred. Use only for the user-authorized tutorial task and the selected app.

action.description: Arguments for the existing computer_use tool; use its current schema and a freshly observed target.

observe.description: Explicit app and window_id matching the recording; optional pid and capture mode.
